name: Thoughteater
body:
School divination [mind-affecting]; Level bard 3, inquisitor 3, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, unchained summoner 3, witch 3

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as detect thoughts except you gain 2 temp hp per creature whose thoughts you read in the 3rd round of the spell. You can gain a maximum number of temp hp from this spell equal to double your class level. This temp hp last for 1 hour and stack with other sources of temp hp except from this spell.
